fingerprint_algorithm: sha256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON excluding contract_fingerprint

outputs.runtime_key_policy: exactly preserve each source grain key set
outputs.runtime_row_count_policy: exactly preserve each source grain row count

runtime_compatibility.date_coverage_rule: output date coverage equals runtime input coverage
runtime_compatibility.key_set_rule: output key set equals runtime input key set
runtime_compatibility.partition_rule: output monthly coverage equals runtime input coverage
runtime_compatibility.row_count_rule: output row count equals runtime input row count
